title: Residue-Level Energetic Analysis of Transient Misfolding in the Whirlin PDZ Tandem Reveals a Possible Connection to an AlphaFold-Predicted Alternative Topology.
authors: Pennacchietti, Valeria; Di Felice, Mariana; Toso, Julian; Ventura, Eduarda Santos; Caldarelli, Laura; Toto, Angelo; Malagrino, Francesca; Gianni, Stefano
one_liner_zh: 该文结合突变能量学分析与AlphaFold预测的替代拓扑，研究whirlin PDZ串联结构域瞬时错误折叠的残基级能量决定因素，虽以实验为主但涉及蛋白质结构计算预测，与课题相关。
abstract: Multidomain proteins may populate transient misfolded states that compete with productive folding, but the molecular determinants of these intermediates remain poorly understood. Using the tandem PDZ domains of the scaffolding protein whirlin, in which a misfolded intermediate accumulates only when both domains are denatured, we combined systematic mutagenesis with a thermodynamic framework analogous to double-mutant cycle analysis. Analysis of ~70 mutations identified residues displaying significant non-additive energetic effects, defining an interaction network concentrated within the connecting hairpins, PDZ2, and a few positions at the PDZ1 interface. Interestingly, AlphaFold predicted an alternative domain-swapped topology differing from the experimentally determined structure primarily within these same regions. Although the experimental data do not establish the structure of the misfolded intermediate, this correspondence suggests that the predicted alternative topology may provide a possible structural interpretation of the experimentally identified energetic determinants. Our findings provide a residue-level characterization of the energetic determinants of transient misfolding in a multidomain protein and suggest a possible connection between these determinants and alternative structural arrangements.
abstract_zh: 多结构域蛋白质可能经历瞬时的错误折叠状态，这些状态与有效折叠竞争，但这些中间体的分子决定因素仍知之甚少。利用支架蛋白whirlin的串联PDZ结构域，其中仅在两个结构域均变性时才会积累错误折叠中间体，我们将系统性突变与类似于双突变循环分析的热力学框架相结合。对约70个突变的分析识别出显示显著非加性效应能量的残基，定义了一个集中在连接发夹、PDZ2以及PDZ1界面少数位置的相互作用网络。有趣的是，AlphaFold预测了一种替代的域交换拓扑结构，其与实验确定的结构主要在这些相同区域存在差异。尽管实验数据并未确立错误折叠中间体的结构，但这种对应关系表明，预测的替代拓扑结构可能为实验识别的能量决定因素提供一种可能的结构解释。我们的发现提供了对多结构域蛋白质中瞬时错误折叠能量决定因素的残基级表征，并暗示了这些决定因素与替代结构排列之间可能存在的联系。
